newsitem.title: USA: BOXING-JONES WINS UNANIMOUS DECISION OVER MCCALLUM.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-JONES WINS UNANIMOUS DECISION OVER MCCALLUM.

text.p: Roy Jones won a doubly unanimous decision over Jamaican Mike McCallum to capture the vacant World Boxing Council light heavyweight championship Friday.

Because of a jurisdictional dispute, three judges from his home state of Florida and three WBC judges separately gave the decision unanimously to Jones, the International Boxing Federation super middleweight champion moving up in weight.
